_doc: Known third-party causes of a game crash or hang (Rodney 2026-11-16): queue.ts marks a job that ends in one of these 'VOID: known cause <id> (<owner>)' and relaunches it once as <id>-kc; a hit on the relaunch is a normal CRASH/FAIL row and today's stop rules apply. Ours until proven: only exact signatures. crash = the EA xcpt report's exception type starts with `exception`, the fault module is `module` and the fault RVA (address - module base, crash-ledger.ts faultRva) is `rva`; without a module base in the report only the low 16 bits are compared and the row says 'weak match'. hang = a kill dump whose lock cycle (tools/dump-locks.ts) has every lock and every lock call in `cycleModules` and nowhere else. `cases` are real lines (machine name and paths replaced) the self-check runs. Matcher: tools/harness/known-causes.ts.

causes.testInstall: in Apex main as patch 0010 (PR 106), not in release 4.0.6; tests since 2026-11-19 use the fork test install ours/test-integration-1119 a69a1bbc (tools/turbo-compat.ts FORK, probe-out/apex-latest-switch-1119.md)
